text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby couldn't blaze through at top 
speed. However, she caught a glimpse of 
what true supreme brilliance feels like 
and came to understand its meaning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is a noble light that serves as a 
beacon for all. To embody that light is 
the mission of her clan—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking to reach that state of mind, she 
set her next sights on the Sprinters 
Stakes. Without realizing it, her heart 
was burning with passion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Daiichi Ruby learned 
that K.S. Miracle, known for her 
terrifying speed, would also be entering 
the Sprinters Stakes—
